title: Color-avoiding tight monotone paths using more than half the colors have Ramsey tower height one below the monochromatic bound
author: Eion Mulrenin, Cosmin Pohoata and Dmitrii Zakharov
difficulty_reason: The authored path-length encoding converts an allowed-color extension into a strict majority in cyclic lexicographic orders. Small tournament dominating sets compress these labels, while the higher-uniformity argument proves every compressed color class excludes a two-edge tight path. This yields the tower-height saving with all parity and coordinate counts retained.
